list: The official 55 trophies, as published on PlayStation Network (list dated 2026-11-18)
provenance: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list, as carried in the make.fun kit starter and cross-checked against PlanetGTA6's list (read from Exophase, checked against PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements) on 2026-11-19. GTA VI launched 2026-11-19, so the list is complete; Rockstar has not posted its own copy. Methods in the guides come from the launch-week guides named in sources; the five trophies whose triggers those guides had not pinned down by 2026-11-19 are marked unconfirmed in their guides instead of being guessed.

gtazone.name: GTA Zone — all 55 trophies and achievements

roadmap.playthroughs: 1 — no difficulty settings, no mission replay, free roam after the story

steps.title: Step 1 — Story and open-world habits (60–80 hours)
steps.text: Play the five chapters and take optional missions as they appear. Meditate at Jason's house in Chapter 1 (the one missable spot), and build habits that pay off later: scan every new vehicle, study animals through the binoculars, and rob and explore as you travel.

steps.title: Step 2 — The 100% Completion checklist (about 100 hours)
steps.text: After the credits the checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion; everything you already did counts. It is lenient — about 60% of true completion: 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 50 of 66 weapons. Nothing on it is missable.

steps.title: Step 3 — Strangers, character finales and cleanup (about 10 hours)
steps.text: Finish the 8 counting Strangers & Freaks strands and the character finales (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone), then sweep whatever one-off trophies remain. Keep cheats off: using one disables trophies and saving for the session.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum: it unlocks by itself the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. There is no extra task, and no multiplayer or DLC is involved — the whole list is single-player.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Gone Fishing, one of the first missions of Chapter 1. It unlocks automatically as you play the opening chapter and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 of the story. Automatic from main-mission progress; just keep playing until the chapter closes.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 of the story. The asterisks are part of the name as PlayStation publishes it. Automatic from main-mission progress and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 of the story. Automatic from main-mission progress and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 of the story. Automatic from main-mission progress and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The second Gold on the list: finish the final story mission. Free roam continues after the credits, so leave all cleanup until after this pops if you prefer.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks as the mission ends and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy for The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 mission. It unlocks as the mission ends and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Child's Play, a Chapter 4 mission. It unlocks as the mission ends and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Headliners, a Chapter 4 mission. It unlocks as the mission ends and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy for VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 mission at the airport. It unlocks as the mission ends and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 mission. It unlocks as the mission ends and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy on the list: finish the 100% Completion checklist, which appears under Progress > Stats after the story — progress made during the story already counts. The checklist is lenient, roughly 60% of true completion: 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 50 of 66 weapons, 15 of 18 card sets. Nothing on it is missable, so work it steadily in free roam.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts of any kind — stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count, and there are 397 in total. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going after this pops and stunts will never be a bottleneck.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity at least once: races, shooting ranges, fishing, arcade games, drone races and the rest of Leonida's pastimes each need a single attempt. Variety is what counts here, not winning — the wins are asked for by other trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in every Shooting Range challenge: 42 gold medals across 12 ranges. The 100% checklist requires all 42 as well, so this one is on the critical path for A Long Road — practise each range's challenge until the gold is yours.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — one win per spot is enough for the trophy. All 42 races across those spots are only needed for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 on offer. Winning the same race twice does not add to the count, so keep moving to events you have not won yet.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal at his fishing challenge. He texts you after a Chapter 1 mission and marks the spot with a purple icon; head there and out-fish him.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game at a cabinet. Finishing a single game is enough — the 100% checklist separately counts 4 video games played, so try a few cabinets while you are there.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand by completing his final mission. His jobs stay available as you play, and the finale closes the strand.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand by completing his final mission. Kenton's set-collection work also feeds the 100% checklist (5 Kenton sets), so his strand pays off twice.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand by completing his final mission. His five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after a Chapter 2 mission, and they stay open after the story ends.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands — but not every strand counts toward the eight. Guide reporting names Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete as counting, while the strands for Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy do not. Prioritise the counting strands and finish them in Step 3 of the roadmap.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand by completing his final mission. It unlocks as the strand closes and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand by completing his final mission. It unlocks as the strand closes and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: Potentially missable (PowerPyx): the first spot, at Jason's house in Chapter 1, is gone after that chapter.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots in 10 locations, using both Jason and Lucia. POTENTIALLY MISSABLE: the first spot is offered at Jason's house in Chapter 1 and becomes permanently unavailable after that chapter, so meditate there before you move on — guides have not confirmed whether the trophy needs it, but do not risk it. The last spot needs Jason and Lucia playable together, which opens after Chapter 2. The 100% checklist only asks for 15 spots, so even a miss cannot block A Long Road.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret sends you after. His hunting quests open after Chapter 2 and are played as Jason only; which animal is the unique target was still unconfirmed in launch-week guides, so follow Bret's quest markers. His target decks (15) also feed the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 Collectible Card sets. The 100% checklist wants 15 sets, so collect steadily as you explore instead of leaving the cards for a final sweep.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK at 100 locations. Any mix counts toward the hundred: the 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags spread across Leonida. The 100% checklist asks for the same 100, so every stop pays twice.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges. The 100% checklist asks for 70, so work through the easy ones first and leave the hardest for last — you may skip ten challenges entirely and still finish everything.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: While you are together with your partner, build up a 4-star Wanted Level, then lose it completely and escape the heat. Pick a spot with a clean escape route — alleys, tunnels or a fast car — before you start the trouble.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without the Wanted Level dropping away in between. Chain them quickly in one district: finish one robbery, drive straight to the next shop, and keep the stars alive until the third is done.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles by scanning them. There are 277 base models in the game and the 100% checklist wants 200 scanned, so make scanning every unfamiliar model a habit from the first hour.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies inside a single Combat Focus activation. Fill the Focus meter first, pick a crowded fight, and use an assault rifle so all five go down before the effect runs out.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, steal a passenger jet parked at a boarding gate, take off, and put roughly a kilometre between you and the airport. That unscheduled departure is the trophy.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a quote and a hint — Rhino is the tank. Guides report the method as: steal a tank at Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies from inside it. Expect heavy resistance at the base, so go in prepared.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — no alarms, no witnesses, no wanted level. Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs give you a Snap Gun for the back door, which is the quiet way in; take that route rather than the front.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 of the 8 bank vaults and escape each time. Vaults open up with an optional Chapter 4 mission, and every vault job brings a 4-star response, so stage a fast bike outside before you go in. The 100% checklist wants all 8 vaults, so finish the set later.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and get away clean. Guides note a bank vault job also counts toward this if you escape, so it may pop during Maximum Withdrawal without a separate hunt.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore the whole of Leonida — clear the fog from the entire map. A plane is the fastest tool for it: sweep the coastline and the Keys in long legs, then mop up any inland patches that stay dark.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation run by each gang — one operation per gang, across all 9 gangs. All 39 operations are only needed for the 100% checklist, so for the trophy just make sure no gang is left out.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: The description points to having a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact trigger was still unconfirmed in launch-week guides, so this entry says so rather than inventing one: try ordering a drink at Ocean Beach bars and lookout spots. (Unconfirmed method, 2026-11-19.)

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom — the description points to driving a car out through the showroom glass. Which showroom and the exact setup were unconfirmed in launch-week guides; vehicle showrooms in Vice City are the place to experiment. (Unconfirmed method, 2026-11-19.)

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Despite the friendly name, guides report this is a robbery: rob the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn — the Kolt & Associates alley — and then lose the police. It can double as one of the gang operations for Pest Control if the gang matches.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Guides read the description as a stats trophy: max out the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. Working out together trains both characters at once, which is the fastest route. (Method as reported by GTA Zone, 2026-11-19.)

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Build up 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile — the choices you make across the game, for better or worse. One warning from the guides: do not push toward the Irredeemable profile, because that one is permanent. (Method as reported by GTA Zone, 2026-11-19.)

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The exact trigger was still unconfirmed in launch-week guides — neither PowerPyx nor GTABase had pinned it down by 2026-11-19. The description hints at succeeding at something on a second attempt after a failure. This entry flags it unconfirmed rather than guessing a location. (Unconfirmed, 2026-11-19.)

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The exact trigger was still unconfirmed in launch-week guides. The name and description point to witnessing one of Leonida's strange, unexplained events out in the world. This entry flags it unconfirmed rather than inventing a spot — watch for odd encounters while exploring for The Goodtime State. (Unconfirmed, 2026-11-19.)

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock over bowling pins with a melee drive-by: drive past a set of pins and swing a melee weapon from the vehicle. Pins stand at bowling venues such as the Kolt & Associates alley in Port Gellhorn; the exact setup was still being pinned down in launch-week guides. (Partly unconfirmed, 2026-11-19.)

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder Marked Bills through your contacts until the running total reaches $250,000 — it accumulates, so every laundering job counts. Of the contacts, Yasmani pays the most, so route bills through him when you can. The same $250,000 is on the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops as a running total. Clothes, weapons, vehicle work and services all count as you play, so this usually arrives on its own during a full run — the garage properties for Little Boxes alone cost about $160,000, though properties are bought outside shops.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties that are for sale, about $160,000 in total. The 4 garages the story gives you do not count toward the eight. Bought garages also give you the space On the Spot needs for registrations.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Moses hands you the app in Chapter 2, and each registration needs free garage space — another reason to buy the garages for Little Boxes early.
